meta.name: portfolio-strategy
meta.description: Decides where capital and attention go across business lines, products, and markets — what to fund, hold, harvest, or exit, and on what evidence. Use this to allocate budget across businesses, evaluate whether a product line should continue, decide whether to exit one, structure a portfolio review, or when several initiatives compete for the same limited investment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清业务线投资优先级，决定追加还是退出
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在多个业务或产品间分配预算，犹豫是否砍掉某个产品线
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize business lines and decide where to invest or exit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often allocate budget across businesses and hesitate to cut a product line

howto.what: Claude 会按“吸引力”和“赢的权利”两轴评估各业务线/产品,给出资助、持有、收割或退出姿势;比较边际回报而非绝对规模,强制排序,并输出每条的证据、建议配置和推翻判断的指标。
howto.when: 当你想分配跨业务/产品/市场的预算、判断某条产品线是否继续或退出,或做组合评审;多个项目争同一笔有限投资时也会触发。

say.text: 按吸引力和我们能否打赢,给三条业务线定投资方向。
say.note: Claude 会给出每条的姿势和建议配置。

say.text: 帮我看这条产品线该重点投入、收割还是退出。
say.note: 它会按边际回报和退出检验来给结论。

say.text: 用组合框架评审现有业务,列出该停掉的和反证指标。
say.note: 输出停止事项和逆转判断的指标。

howto.what_en: Claude scores each business line/product on attractiveness and right to win, assigns a posture (fund, hold, harvest, exit), compares marginal return rather than absolute size, forces a ranking, and returns evidence, suggested allocation, and reversal indicators.
howto.when_en: Use when allocating budget across businesses/products/markets, judging whether a product line should continue or exit, structuring a portfolio review, or when several initiatives compete for the same limited investment.

say_en.text: Set funding direction for three business lines by attractiveness and right to win
say_en.note: Returns posture and suggested allocation for each.

say_en.text: Should I keep, harvest, or exit this product line?
say_en.note: Gives a conclusion based on marginal return and exit test.

say_en.text: Run a portfolio review; list what to stop and reversal indicators
say_en.note: Outputs stops and indicators that would reverse each call.
